blocks.text: Harbor & Oak abandoned-cart email design

This is the working cut for HBR-TDD-2022-028 on April 26, 2022. Dana Whitlock asked for a written bound after the current path (No abandoned-cart mail, Dana sending by hand after a slow day) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host email.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on custom Node mailer on email.harbor.internal, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Klaviyo for abandoned cart. Suppress if pickup_store is set or the POS sold the SKU in the last 2 hours. Reject a custom Node sender ($4.9k, Dana owns unsubscribes). I am not restating a hallway yes. custom Node mailer on email.harbor.internal is out because Dana does not want to own CAN-SPAM from a VPS. Klaviyo already does unsubscribes. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at cost=4.9, hours=2, recover=8.4, list=1904, weeks=4, pickup=1, unsub=0.6, carts=22.1. Sibling tickets HBR-2806 and HBR-PRD-2022-034. I will not reopen custom Node mailer on email.harbor.internal in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Nia Brooks owns a leftover that is easy to skip: sync.harbor.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (20): refuse on custom Node mailer on email.harbor.internal, lock is Klaviyo, pickup suppress, 2-hour POS suppress. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HBR-2806.
I will not let a tool email people who already picked up in the store because the cart still looks open.

What a skeptical user would try first on email.harbor.internal: the path Dana Whitlock actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on shop.harbor.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
